title: FlexMoRE: A Flexible Mixture of Rank-heterogeneous Experts for Efficient Federatedly-trained Large Language Models
selection_reason: FlexMoRE combines routed low-rank experts with full-size base experts at inference and reports substantially lower parameter and accelerator-memory requirements while maintaining or improving benchmark performance. The reported memory reductions are derived from model/expert sizes rather than runtime memory or latency benchmarks, but the mechanism directly targets MoE serving footprint and merits downstream review.
